QUOTE: `scripts/generate_errors.pl` scans `include/mbedtls/*.h` with a regex for `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<NAME> -0x<hex>`... It fills the template `scripts/data_files/error.fmt` and writes `library/error.c`. The output is checked in.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that generate_errors.pl produces library/error.c from the public headers using error.fmt as the template.
